# Svatební galerie – Pavel Prokeš

> Private online wedding galleries by Pavel Prokeš, a wedding photographer based in Prague, Czech Republic. Couples and their guests open a gallery from a link or QR code, view and download the photos, and — when the couple allows it — add their own photos from the wedding. The only public page is a short help page, in Czech, English and French.

Gallery contents are private: every gallery is reached only through its own link, sometimes with a password, and is not listed or indexed. Questions about booking, prices or the photographer's work belong to the main site.

## Help

- [Wedding gallery help](https://photos.svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/): where to get the gallery link or QR code, what to do without the password, why a link stops working, offline viewing and downloading everything at once.

## Key facts

- A gallery never expires on its own. A link stops working only if the photographer gives it a time limit or turns it off.
- After five wrong password attempts the link locks for 15 minutes for everyone who has it. Only the photographer knows the password.
- "Download all" gives the whole gallery as one ZIP, ready a few minutes after the photographer finishes uploading. Until then photos can be downloaded one by one.

## Photographer

- [Pavel Prokeš – svatební fotograf](https://svatebni-fotograf-cechy.cz/): portfolio, prices, booking and contact.
